culprit_citations.quoted_text: Twin Star International, Inc. | Term Loan - 11.35% inc PIK | Fair Value: -

findings.detail: B01's denominator includes non-position schedule labels with structurally blank fair-value cells; a dash on a genuine position is a disclosed zero, not missing data.

rationale: The raw SOI separates industry labels from investment rows. Table 4 row 3 is only the industry label 'Aerospace & Defense' and has no fair-value cell, so counting it as a leaf with missing fair value pollutes the B01 denominator. In contrast, genuine investment rows disclose fair value, including table 4 row 17 where an em dash denotes zero; the extracted holdings sample correctly represents that position at 0.0. The filing's schedule total is explicitly $1,239,482,127 at table 7 row 32. Thus the 72.3% cell-coverage flag does not establish missing position fair values and is a rule-scope false alarm.
